control.title: Transaction fraud monitoring and limits
control.description: Monitor transactions in real time with documented fraud rules (velocity, geo-location, device, high-risk merchants, failed authentications), set and review transaction limits, staff a 24x7 fraud desk, and analyse the root cause of frauds.

implementation_notes: Implemented at Paisa Setu Fintech and reviewed annually.
evidence_hint: Fraud rule set, limit configuration, monitoring dashboard or alert samples, fraud RCA reports, 24x7 roster.
acceptance_criteria: Documented fraud monitoring rules and transaction limits that were reviewed in the last 12 months
Evidence that alerts are raised and handled, including outside business hours
Root-cause analysis for frauds or a fraud review

criteria_coverage.criterion: Documented fraud monitoring rules and transaction limits that were reviewed in the last 12 months
Evidence that alerts are raised and handled, including outside business hours
Root-cause analysis for frauds or a fraud review

requirements.title: PCI DSS, encryption and fraud prevention
requirements.guidance: Systems that detect and prevent fraud and protect customers; PCI DSS (and PA-DSS) compliance with current encryption standards.

requirements.title: Monitor merchant transactions against their profile
requirements.guidance: Monitor merchant transactions for consistency with the merchant's business.

requirements.title: MFA for debits, real-time fraud monitoring, 24x7 desk, 5-year logs
requirements.guidance: MFA for electronic debits unless relaxed, real-time fraud monitoring, a manned 24x7x365 desk for fraud complaints and law enforcement, audit logs kept at least five years, anti-phishing and rogue-app takedown.

requirements.title: Risk alerts, masked notifications and fraud flagging
requirements.guidance: Online alerts on failed transactions, velocity and geo-location; masked account and card details; merchant name (not the gateway) in messages with the OTP at the end; customers can flag fraud in the app or website.

evidence.title: Transaction fraud monitoring and limits: how we do it
